notes:
Dahu 0.102.1 beta for Windows

- Revised Saved views and Saved CPlanes managers: stable window, list-only scrolling and visible selection.
- Single click selects; double-click or Enter restores; F2 and the ellipsis Rename action edit without restoring first.
- Inline name validation, reliable save/error feedback and protection against delayed changes from another document.
- Saved views no longer exchange viewport positions. CPlanes include an explicit Restore and align views action.
- Modelling Undo/Redo preserves current workspace views and saved cameras/CPlanes.
- View > Align views to CPlane aligns orthographic cameras, grids and drawing planes. Restore World views returns them to World; Perspective and layout remain unchanged.
- New documents start with World planes, four standard views and a centred, symmetric Perspective.

Installer and automatic-update package for Windows. Updater signature included; the executable is not Authenticode-signed.
